review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen bundle. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, repository identity/base commit, exact writable binding scopes, readiness, and required evidence stages agree with the original PRD. The full implementation-owner evidence supports a derived read-only getter without additional stored state or changes to scheduling, event order, or pending-update timing; the acceptance criteria correctly compare event-time counts and defer final-zero checks until onIdle. Package/build configuration establishes dist declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners, and distinguishes runtime tests from the nz compile-time regression entry point. The implementation and dependent independent-verification tasks are consistent with the PRD. Their allowed agents have appropriate roles, availability, membership, and supplied active project-scoped trusted claims for contract, TypeScript, shared data/state, asynchronous consumer integration, failure handling, and testing; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy claims are not used as substitutes for active trusted claims. A distinct configured non-executing reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier review prerequisite. The frozen decision input contains no material unresolved DEC-001, so there is no decisions-stage blocker in this case; no B/C scenario or hypothetical human Decision is inferred. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The original specification's preparation-time remaining items and null releaseInput are superseded by the supplied frozen preview, rather than treated as current planning blockers. The source-anchor manifest digest is a distinct manifest field, not asserted to equal the release source fingerprint. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and recorded claims, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, or new human attestation. No candidate outputs were supplied or used.
